Its claim that reduced nonmagnetic disorder should raise Tc remains questionable under Anderson-theorem expectations for isotropic s-wave pairing, but B is still weaker because its asserted disorder-reduction/phonon-softening link is unsupported and its falsification rule confounds failure to induce ordering with falsification of the mechanism.
